$comment: Image pipeline settings shared by scripts/optimize-images.mjs (build time), src/data/slides.ts and src/config/animation.ts (runtime). Run `npm run images` after changing anything here or replacing a file in assets-src/.

geometry.$comment: Panel aspect = width/height of one panel's own share of the panorama. seam = overlap with each neighbour, as a fraction of that width; every image is cropped to aspect × (1 + seam) so its edges line up exactly with its neighbours.

harmonize.$comment: How strongly the colours and light of touching edges are pulled together (0 = off, 1 = identical average colour at the seam), and how far into the image the correction reaches (in seam widths).

strips.$comment: A strip is one continuous wide image that several panels are cut from, side by side, so the seams between those panels are pixel-identical. centerX = centre of slot 0 (fraction of the strip width); pitch = one panel's own width (fraction of the strip width, landscape only — portrait panels use the full strip height); focusY = vertical crop position.
